note: On the lake side at the west end of the Carlyle Lake dam, beside a marina and the lake visitor center. The best sites are on the south-east shore (about 47-55), on lawn above a riprap bank; the inner sites are wooded. A trail crosses the dam to Dam East. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates, catalog and calendar read: USACE-run, 108 reservable back-in electric sites (50 A; full hookups at 75-97), $20 (2026, 2027), all reservable incl. same day, 14 in 30; flush toilets, dump, drinking water. Groups written manual; note cleaned. Lakefront confirmed at the south-east shore sites. Pin ok. Not below the dam.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, not --AWH): CONFIRMED with a riprap caveat. Esri imagery (0.24 m/px) with catalog points: sites 049 (38.631249,-89.355499), 050 (38.631004,-89.35566), 051 (38.630845,-89.35583), 054 (38.630646,-89.356085) and 055 (38.630505,-89.356304) are back-in pads on open lawn ~18-25 m from the water with no road between, the shore a riprap band; 047 (38.631432,-89.355317) and 045 ~16-22 m but under scattered trees; 041/042 under canopy. 3DEP: site 054 138.3 m vs pool 135.6 m (~2.7 m above). All are nightly reservable sites. Suggest the caveat name sites 49-55 and the riprap bank.
DAM CHECK: Dam West is on the LAKE side at the west end of the dam (open lake east of the sites, the marina south); not below the dam.
